Bitget remained the largest intake at 464.2 million dollars, up from 436.7 million, and Bitstamp intake rose to 211.9 million dollars from 182.0 million, while Gate took in 212.2 million dollars. OKX posted a 71.6 million dollar outflow, the largest departure, and Bitfinex's outflow widened to 53.4 million dollars from 12.5 million, while clean-asset intake across 79 venues was a 1,110.9 million dollar net inflow, 0.399 percent of the 278.5 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, which means money is still arriving on exchanges as those two venues send dollars out.
